failure_clusters.does_not_prove: That a static trailing stop universally fixes the exit efficiency across all symbols.
evidence: Average MFE is 1.187R while average MAE is -1.043R with net result -26.98R

hypotheses.falsification_test: Run intratrade path historical simulation with trailing stop activated at 0.50R MFE and verify net R improvement without excessive whipsaw exits.
hypotheses.single_axis_change: Apply a trailing stop-loss activation once trade MFE crosses +0.50R to protect open equity.
hypotheses.why: High average MFE (1.187R) combined with deep negative net R indicates failure to lock in profits once trades reach favorable excursions.
